description: All points are on longitude 0, so a straight line is the Earth's radius (6,371,008.8 m) times the difference of latitude in radians: 0.001 degrees is 111.19508 m, a walk of 111.19508 x 1.33 / 80 = 1.8486182 minutes. Two stations near the cell (4 and 9 minutes) and two near the place (1.8486182 and 3.6972364 minutes). The four ways: 4 + 30 + 1.8486 = 35.85, 4 + 25 + 3.6972 = 32.70, 9 + 20 + 1.8486 = 30.85 and 9 + 18 + 3.6972364177649695 = 30.69723641776497, the quickest.
